objects.name: Mobile First Screen
objects.purpose: Create curiosity immediately without explaining everything.
requirements: Name and first route objects visible on 390px mobile.
A below-fold hint should be visible on common mobile viewports.
No visible category heading is required for comprehension.

objects.name: Mobile Route Clusters
objects.purpose: Group routes visually through spacing and object rhythm.
requirements: Each route object remains at least 44px high.
Cluster labels should be aria labels, not visible section headings.

objects.name: Desktop Front Room
objects.purpose: Loosen desktop into a front-room composition.

responsive.behavior: Use asymmetric object placement while preserving reading order.

requirements: Desktop must not become a centered SaaS hero.

build_rules: Mobile layout is the canonical design; desktop adapts it.
Do not introduce a landing-page hero or marketing CTA block.
